sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Connect knowledge into this brain: text, a website, a GitHub repo, a SQL database or a webhook. Each source ingests documents as memories.
sources.emptyBody: Sources bring knowledge into this brain. Add one to start ingesting.
sources.deleteBody: The connector is removed. Memories it already ingested stay in the brain.
sources.blurb.webhook: Push documents in from anywhere. You get a URL and a secret to POST to.
sources.blurb.text: Paste plain text to ingest it as memories.
sources.blurb.markdown: Paste markdown to ingest it as memories.
sources.blurb.crawler: Crawl a website from a start URL and ingest its pages.
sources.blurb.github: Ingest files from a repository path.
sources.blurb.sql: Run a query against a database and ingest the rows.
sources.blurb.mcp: Pull context from an MCP server.
sources.field.name: Name
sources.field.title: Title
sources.ph.name: e.g. Product docs
sources.secretNote: Stored server-side and never shown again.
sources.webhookNote: A push URL and secret are generated when you add it. You'll copy them next.
sources.webhookReadyHint: POST documents to this URL with the secret header. Copy the secret now; it won't be shown again.
sources.secretHidden: The secret is hidden after creation. Delete and re-add the source to get a new one.
